description: This file implements dependency path analysis and search functionality for a build system, including path printing, path classification, and breadth-first search for dependency paths between targets.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Configuration options for dependency path search, including output type, public-only filter, and data dependencies inclusion.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Tracks statistics of found paths, including counts of public and other paths, and a map of targets to path types.

methods.name: ClassifyPath
methods.description: Classifies a dependency path based on the most significant dependency type in the path.

methods.name: StringForDepType
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a dependency type.

methods.name: PrintPath
methods.description: Prints a dependency path with optional annotation for the last dependency type.

methods.name: InsertTargetsIntoFoundPaths
methods.description: Inserts targets from a path into the found paths map, updating path statistics.

methods.name: BreadthFirstSearch
methods.description: Performs a breadth-first search to find dependency paths between two targets, considering dependency types and printing options.

methods.name: DoSearch
methods.description: Runs dependency path searches with different dependency inclusion options based on user settings.

methods.name: RunPath
methods.description: Main function to execute the 'gn path' command, parsing arguments, setting up environment, performing searches, and outputting results.
